integrity: Exact factorization-based arithmetic regression is finite; the infinite proof explicitly uses the prime number theorem in arithmetic progressions. Earlier unindexed literature may contain a similar formula.
scientific_limitations: The asymptotic is pointwise in each fixed odd prime; no uniformity in the least prime and no global count of all arithmetic-derivative/totient coincidences is claimed. The existence construction was already known in the OEIS entry; no independent external validation has been performed.
title: A harmonic counting law for two-prime arithmetic-derivative–totient coincidences
